groups.speaker: lula
groups.claim: O Brasil tem hoje 17,5 milhões de MEIs

decisions.reason: D checks only the MEI count. C covers both the creation of the MEI and the count, but its excerpt opens by checking the 17.5 million figure against official data, so the count is the shared claim.

C checks the claim that Bolsonaro's first act was MP 871 against INSS fraud and that the PT opposed it, while D checks a different statement, that the PT caucus pushed an amendment favoring unions and uncontrolled deductions. The topic is the same, but the assertions are not.
